title: "Contact"
# description: "Enquire about English coaching, pronunciation sessions and workshops."
---

<p class="eyebrow">

GET IN TOUCH

</p>

**Email: ryand25\@tcd.ie**

1.  **Arrange a free 15 minute call to discuss your needs.**

Don't worry if you are nervous to talk in person. Please remember that it is my job to help people to build their fluency in English.

Just tell me some times you are free and we'll have a chat.

2.  **Write to me with your needs**

-   Tell me what you would like to learn.

-   What do you need English for (work, travel, exams, etc.)?

-   Are you an individual or a group?

-   Do you want online classes or in-person?

    (Dublin / Wicklow only)
    
    
## Send an enquiry

<form action="https://formsubmit.co/ryand25@tcd.ie" method="POST">

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="name" class="form-label">Your name</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control" id="name"
           name="name" required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="email" class="form-label">ryand25@tcd.ie</label>
    <input type="email" class="form-control" id="email"
           name="email" required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="interest" class="form-label">What are you interested in?</label>
    <select class="form-select" id="interest" name="interest" required>
      <option value="">Please select</option>
      <option>Pronunciation coaching</option>
      <option>General English</option>
      <option>Professional communication</option>
      <option>Workshops and training</option>
      <option>English in Wicklow</option>
      <option>Other</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="message" class="form-label">Your message</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" id="message"
              name="message" rows="6"
              placeholder="Tell me a little about what you're looking for..."
              required></textarea>
  </div>

  <input type="hidden" name="_subject"
         value="New enquiry from English Teaching website">

  <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="true">

  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
    Send enquiry
  </button>

</form>
